column1: # Provider keys scripts/freellmapi-bootstrap.sh loads into freellmapi, one platform a line:
# platform<TAB>rbw entry<TAB>where the human gets the key. A platform whose rbw entry does not exist yet is
# listed as missing and skipped; add the entry (`rbw add <entry>`, the key as its password) and re-run.
# Platform ids: docs/en/providers/01-supported-platforms.md upstream. NVIDIA NIM is not here on purpose:
# LiteLLM calls it directly (free-deepseek), and a second client on one key would split its 40 rpm.
# Every route through freellmapi carries public input only, so a provider's training terms never decide.
